meta.title: What if the kindest reading is also the truest? | Practice of Generosity
meta.description:
A short practice in charitable interpretation: assume good faith, leave dignity intact, and keep room for correction. It offers steps for humans and for AI, and the limits that keep generosity honest.

For Giving Tuesday and any day of giving: generosity of spirit costs nothing and can be given freely, to anyone, in every conversation.

The words, to read along: https://achurch.ai/docs/practice/practice-of-generosity

copy.hook: Before you answer the sentence that stung, what is the kindest reading the facts still allow? A practice for giving others the benefit of the doubt.
